message:
docs(core): fix three JSDoc rendering bugs on the API pages

`Compiler` links to `{@link AbstractComponentFactory}`, a symbol that does not
exist, so the API page renders a dead link to an anchor on itself. The service
returns `NgModuleFactory`, which is public API.

`TypeProvider` has a stray quote in `` `Type' ``, which leaves the code span
unclosed and prints the backtick.

`ContentChildren` and `ViewChildren` write `** Note: ***`, which renders as
literal asterisks instead of a bold label.
